Notes: Amesha Vizaresh (PD01), Pandemonium Caina 4328: gauntlet info ghost (L1/25 HP, NoCombat). Lines from live capture dialogs_20261109_Cattywompus.

when.Text: How long until the Gauntlet opens up again?

hello.Text: The apparition before you glares as you approach, its beak-like mouth somehow turning downward into a rather dire frown. It speaks, after a moment, its voice low and rumbling. Yes.... what do you want?

when.Text: The ghostly creature sighs with resignation. It will be roughly six of your hours before I return to life... if there is nothing else, then I ask that you leave me be.
